manifest.base_kind_fields_reason: Adds condition, deposit and category fields to the machines already kept as Machines; who has a tool and until when is the platform loan (Lend... on the tool), not a field of its own.

releases.notes: Who has a tool and when it is due back is the loan you make with Lend on the tool, so the Borrower and Due back fields are gone from new installs. A workspace where nobody typed into them has them hidden; one that did keeps them as they were.
A group's summary adds up only what adds up: a length or a weight per item is totalled as length or weight times how many you have, and a year, a size or a temperature is no longer summed.

manifest.name: Tool Library
manifest.description: Lend your tools out: who has one, when it is due back and its condition. Condition, deposit and category fields on your machines; lending itself is Lend... on the tool.
manifest.author: Cobblr community
